[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Fibonacci number** [LC 509 · Fibonacci Number](https://leetcode.com/problems/fibonacci-number/){difficulty="Easy"}

The direct recursion $T(n) = T(n-1) + T(n-2) + O(1)$ makes $2F(n+1) - 1 = \Theta(\varphi^n)$ calls (checked in @sec-cx-recurrences), because the two branches recompute the same values. There are only $n+1$ distinct states, so memoisation makes it linear.

[Solved in full in @sec-cx-p4-fib.]{.card-link}
